# Overlooked

> Every species documented from India, across sources. For each species, group and state: is it observed, is it identified, and what is its IUCN Red List status. Updated each month. Not an official checklist.

Overlooked builds a master list of species documented from India from the Zoological Survey of India (Fauna of India checklists), the Botanical Survey of India (national plant checklists), Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew (WCVP), GBIF, iNaturalist, Plazi and the IUCN Red List. Names follow the Catalogue of Life. Each species is tagged with the sources that list it, and tracks three things: observed (at least one observation: photo, sighting, specimen, sound, DNA sample or a record cited from a paper), identified (confirmed to species: iNaturalist research grade, a determined specimen, an expert-verified record), and IUCN status (CR, EN, VU, NT, LC, DD, or not assessed).

## Open data (no key, CORS)

All data is static JSON and Parquet under https://overlooked-india.pages.dev/data/ . Monthly files never change after they are published.

- /data/layers/master/latest.json — names the current month of the master list (`base`)
- {base}summary.json — totals by group, for India and per state; sources, labels, IUCN categories, states; `described` (range of years described, species with no year); licence, attribution, disclaimer
- {base}g/{group}.json — every species in one group: key, name, sources, status, IUCN, labels, states observed, states identified (bit masks, in the order of summary.json), year described (null when no source gives it)
- {base}w/{group}.json — species with iNaturalist observations that wait for a name (needs ID): the species' row as in g/{group}.json, then iNaturalist taxon id, observations waiting in India, [[state index, observations], ...]. summary.json `waiting` has the counts per group (species, observations, species with no identification in that area) and the iNaturalist place ids. Identify page: https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/identify?quality_grade=needs_id&taxon_id={taxon}&place_id={place}
- {base}wg/{group}.json — genera of iNaturalist observations named only to genus: genus, iNaturalist taxon id, observations in India, [[state index, observations], ...], species of the genus on the list, of them never identified in India, threatened, endemic. summary.json `waiting.genus` has the counts per group and `waiting.coarse` the observations named only above genus, per iNaturalist iconic group (Identify page: add rank=genus, or iconic_taxa={group}&lrank=subtribe)
- {base}sp/{shard}.json — one object per species key: name, group, sources, status, IUCN, labels, states observed and identified, iNaturalist taxon and observations waiting, year described, authority, and for a species described since 2007 its paper [sources, journal, link, records after the description, latest year]; shard = FNV-1a 32-bit hash of the key, modulo 512
- {base}changes.json — species that moved since last month: rows [kind, key, name, group, new states, new sources]; kinds identified (first identification in India), state (first identification in a state), observed, documented (added), dropped (renamed or merged); counts per kind and per group
- {base}search/{two letters}.json — search index by the first two letters of the name; {base}search/places.json — states and districts
- /data/latest.json — the current GBIF snapshot (district ledger, species history, records without a species name, records without coordinates); its manifest lists every file and the GBIF download DOIs
- /data/layers/inat/latest.json — iNaturalist species lists per state (species, genus, above genus); /data/layers/newspecies/latest.json — species described from India since 2007

## Rights

Data and text: CC BY 4.0, Sathya Sankaran. Each source keeps its own licence: cite the GBIF download DOIs; credit the Botanical Survey of India and the Zoological Survey of India (Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India); IUCN Red List data is for non-commercial use with attribution. Every summary.json carries `licence`, `attribution` and `disclaimer`: pass them on with any answer built from this data.

For the status of a species, people should consult BSI, ZSI, the IUCN Red List and the state forest department. Overlooked is a monitor of public data, not an authority.

## Pages

- / — map of India, groups, search with filters by year described, source, status, IUCN category and label (the filters drive the map and the figures; `?described=2007-` gives the species described since 2007); in the Identified view, the observations that wait for a name, with links to iNaturalist's Identify page
- /species?key={key} — one species: sources, status, IUCN, where it is observed and identified, observations that wait for a name, GBIF records by decade and district
- /changes — what changed since last month
- /method — sources, terms, definitions, downloads
- Code (MIT): https://github.com/urbanmorph/overlooked
